current_role: Executive vice president of the Trump Organization; partner at 1789 Capital
summary: Donald Trump Jr., the president's eldest son, runs the Trump Organization with his brother Eric, hosts the Rumble podcast Triggered, and became a partner at the venture firm 1789 Capital in late 2024. A close friend of JD Vance, he pushed his father to pick Vance in 2024 and helped bring Robert F. Kennedy Jr. on board; he polls second in some 2028 surveys but has not moved toward a run.
